title: Sparkly glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lensL' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bfe9ff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#5fa8d3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a7ca5'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='lensR' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bfe9ff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#5fa8d3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a7ca5'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- left lens frame -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='17' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- left lens glass -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='12.5' fill='url(#lensL)'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='47' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- right lens frame -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='17' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- right lens glass -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='12.5' fill='url(#lensR)'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='47' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- bridge -->
  <path d='M47 50 Q50 44 53 50' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M47 50 Q50 44 53 50' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- temples / arms -->
  <path d='M13 48 L6 44' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M87 48 L94 44' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <path d='M16 20 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M82 18 l2.4 6 l6 2.4 l-6 2.4 l-2.4 6 l-2.4 -6 l-6 -2.4 l6 -2.4 z'/>
    <path d='M50 12 l1.8 4.5 l4.5 1.8 l-4.5 1.8 l-1.8 4.5 l-1.8 -4.5 l-4.5 -1.8 l4.5 -1.8 z'/>
    <path d='M88 74 l1.6 4 l4 1.6 l-4 1.6 l-1.6 4 l-1.6 -4 l-4 -1.6 l4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M12 78 l1.4 3.5 l3.5 1.4 l-3.5 1.4 l-1.4 3.5 l-1.4 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.4 l3.5 -1.4 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#fff1b8'>
    <path d='M68 82 l1.2 3 l3 1.2 l-3 1.2 l-1.2 3 l-1.2 -3 l-3 -1.2 l3 -1.2 z'/>
    <path d='M32 80 l1.2 3 l3 1.2 l-3 1.2 l-1.2 3 l-1.2 -3 l-3 -1.2 l3 -1.2 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
